title: Queue — First In, First Out
steps: [{"i": 0, "contents": [], "op": "start", "note": "A queue serves in arrival order \u2014 first in, first out."}, {"i": 0, "contents": [7], "op": "enqueue 7", "note": "7 joins at the back."}, {"i": 1, "contents": [7, 4], "op": "enqueue 4", "note": "4 joins at the back."}, {"i": 2, "contents": [7, 4, 9], "op": "enqueue 9", "note": "9 joins at the back."}, {"i": 2, "contents": [4, 9], "op": "dequeue 7", "note": "7 arrived first, so it leaves first \u2014 from the front, not the back."}, {"i": 3, "contents": [4, 9, 1], "op": "enqueue 1", "note": "1 joins at the back."}, {"i": 3, "contents": [9, 1], "op": "dequeue 4", "note": "4 arrived first, so it leaves first \u2014 from the front, not the back."}, {"i": 4, "contents": [9, 1, 5], "op": "enqueue 5", "note": "5 joins at the back."}, {"i": 4, "contents": [1, 5], "op": "dequeue 9", "note": "9 arrived first, so it leaves first \u2014 from the front, not the back."}]
